title: 2025 Chinese online-education study of 14px font and 1.5 line spacing
statement:
A 2025 study of Chinese online-education interfaces with 161 children found 14px font size paired with 1.5 line spacing to optimize learning-related readability, reading speed, visual fatigue, and learning efficacy in that tested context.

Options:
- Study-tested optimum: 14px / 1.5 (fits: educational, balanced)
- Larger reading: 16px / 1.5 (fits: friendly, comfortable)
- High readability: 18px / 1.5 (fits: access-first, playful)
- Extra airy: 16px / 1.6 (fits: calm, friendly)
appliesWhen: Applies to: education, mobile web, web apps. Audience: children under 10, general.

source.title: Evaluating the Effect of Font Size and Line Spacing in Chinese Online Education User Interfaces on Children’s Learning Experience
source.authors: Ruichen Niu; Wei Wu; Qiang Li; Yudong Fang
